headline: US and China agree AI incident channel at Trump-Xi summit
body: The day's single story was a hopeful one. After a Washington summit where Xi Jinping said AI must stay under human control, the US and China agreed to set up a communication mechanism for AI-related incidents, with an AI dialogue set for November. Trump added that the US would not slow its own AI efforts. A crisis line between the two AI superpowers boosts Global Coordination and lowers Catastrophic Risk, which sharply reduces Self-Destruction and lifts Gatekeeper, the ending where nations jointly keep AI in check. It also gave 1984 a small lift, since that ending feeds on state coordination too. Horizon Balance rose to -9.47.
movers_note: Self-Destruction -0.9 (-0.84), Gatekeeper +0.6 (+0.56) and 1984 +0.3 (+0.32), all from the US-China incident channel.
